reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of exact native source, enlarged source page, complete unchanged native RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The two distinct dark-brown eyebrow hair shapes are now visibly restored. The rounded chin sits close to the collar with a short broad transition rather than the former elongated yellow funnel. Brown flight cap, forehead goggles, brown side fringe, neutral single mouth, forward bust and warm directional light remain. The two beige collar sides retain the source's dark open V and dark inner layer, without a closed fastening, long neck, clipping or cream bib. No separate eye spectacles or facial hair was invented. Full white/cyan comparisons show a genuine transparent exterior with no working-matte halo, interior holes or see-through clothing.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema0..254 with no visible interior holes or matte halo. Near-opacity values252..254 are not by themselves a rejection under visible-alpha-v1. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The tiny source does not reliably resolve separate eye spectacles or fine goggle hardware; no such accessories were invented and those uncertainties are not grounds for rejection.
entries.canonical_write_boundary: Art approval and byte-identical generated_fullsize archival are complete. No concurrent generated.json write was attempted while the separate built-in owner is active.
